PrashantKatiyar

Head of AI & Applied Technology GenAI, Computer Vision & NLP Expert | Multi-Agent Systems Specialist

Bengaluru, Karnataka India I +91-8591158873 # bluprashant@gmail.com (cid:130) linkedin.com/in/prashantkatiyar

Professional Summary

Visionary AI leader with 7+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and leading end-to-end AI systems from research to production. Currently Heading AI at SafetyWhat AI, where I own the full AI stack — multimodal LLMs, Lang- Graph/AutoGen multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, computer vision models, and scalable inference on Kubernetes/Triton. Proven track record of delivering production- grade, zero-downtime agentic workflows and state-of-the-art computer vision systems that reduce compute costs by 3x+ while maintaining or improving accuracy. Deep expertise across foundational models, transformers, fine-tuning, RAG, agentic ar- chitectures, MLOps, cloud-native deployment, and leading cross-functional/global teams.

Core Competencies & Technical Skills

Python (expert), C++, C#, PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Spacy, NLTK, BERT/GPT variants, OpenRouter, Modal, Haystack, NVIDIA Triton, TensorRT, LLMs (fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, RAG, agentic flows), Transformers, Foundational Models, Computer Vision, NLP, Multimodal AI, OCR (Tesseract, EasyOCR, PaddleOCR), PDF processing (PyMuPDF, LayoutParser), Vector DBs, Unstructured pipelines, AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, ECS, Lambda, S3), GCP Vertex AI, Kubernetes, Docker, MLOps: MLflow, CI/CD, model monitoring, Django, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, CUDA, OpenGL, DeepSpeed, FSDP

Professional Experience

April 2023 – Present

Head of AI & Applied Technology, SafetyWhat AI, India (global remote teams) - Lead entire AI organization’s strategy & execution; own roadmap, architecture, and delivery of production GenAI + CV systems serving 100K+ daily users with zero-downtime requirements

Designed and deployed multi-agent systems using LangGraph + Shimmy + Llama-3 with RAG over PDFs, sensor data → 92%+ automation in diagnosis reporting

Built end-to-end RAG pipelines for unstructured safety reports and video transcripts (EasyOCR + LayoutParser + LLM) → structured JSON

Engineered scalable inference on Kubernetes + NVIDIA Triton with auto-scaling, canary deployments, model versioning, and active monitoring

Fine-tuned Mistral-7B, Phi-3, Llama-3-8B using LoRA/QLoRA → 3–4x lower cost than GPT-4 while matching/exceeding quality

Established MLOps best practices: GitHub Actions CI/CD, Prometheus + Grafana monitoring, feedback loops, GDPR compliance, A/B testing

Delivered executive ROI/KPI reporting; 40%+ reduction in manual audits, 3x faster incident response

Mentored team of 10 engineers/data scientists across India and APAC time zones

Aug 2022 – May 2023

Artificial Intelligence Engineer, Kami Vision, Bengaluru, India - Developed contextual object detection on ARM NPU (Ethos-U); outperformed YOLOv5/v8

by 18% mAP in senior-care environments

Built automated video analysis pipeline using LLMs for captioning → 85% reduction in human review

Managed Kubernetes inference fleet; quantization, distillation, dynamic batching → 60% monthly compute savings

1/2

Senior Research Associate, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore - Led SOTA multimodal data fusion pipeline; millions of inferences/min using PySpark and

MLflow

Designed real-time anomaly detection system using PySpark streaming + Redis ultra-low- latency caching

Productionized architecture on AWS SageMaker + Kubernetes with industry partners

car images + PDF reports (OCR + LayoutParser + fine-tuned Donut/BERT)

Optimized CNNs (EfficientDet, ResNeXt) → 3x inference speedup on mobile GPUs - Integrated regression models into Django production web app AI Software Developer, Resson (Canada-based AgriTech), Remote (India) - Designed drone multispectral + satellite (Sentinel-2, Planet) pipeline for yield prediction,

pest detection, water logging, winter-damaged canopies (22% higher accuracy)

Built PyTorch semantic segmentation & change detection models on TB-scale imagery using NDVI/NDWI/thermal bands

Developed automated orthomosaic generation and real-time pest/water-stress alerting system

Deployed on AWS SageMaker with automated retraining triggers

Computer Vision Engineer, Evolve Technologies, Pune, India - Built real-time X-ray baggage screening system using dual-energy imaging, CUDA-
